title: Kestrel Robotics reports preliminary FY2025 results
text: SAN JOSE - Kestrel Robotics today released preliminary, unaudited results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Kestrel Robotics reported preliminary FY2025 revenue of $398M, up 14% year over year, driven by recurring fleet-software subscriptions. Final audited figures will be published in the annual filing. Forward-looking statements apply.

facts.statement: Kestrel Robotics reported preliminary FY2025 revenue of $398M, up 14% year over year.
